ideas.topic: Mitigating Zero-Variance Starvation (ZVF) in GRPO via Adaptive Reward-Trajectory Entropy Gating
ideas.title: Differentiable Memory Manifolds with Dynamic Phase-Space Caching
ideas.problem_statement: KV-cache memory footprints bottleneck throughput during long-sequence auto-regressive decoding.
ideas.core_mechanism: Project KV tokens onto Riemannian smooth manifolds and perform continuous geodesic interpolation rather than discrete token retention.
ideas.key_assumptions: Token representations lie on a low-dimensional sub-manifold embedded within high-dimensional residual space.
ideas.expected_impact: 85% reduction in KV-cache VRAM consumption without degrading multi-turn context cohesion.

evaluation.critique: High novelty in combining spectral decomposition, but Chebyshev polynomial bounds suffer from numerical instability in high-dimensional state space.
evaluation.suggested_causal_pivot: Pivot from unbounded Chebyshev polynomials to bounded Legendre orthogonal polynomials with adaptive spectral truncation.

ideas.title: Sparse Entropic Attention via Quantum-Inspired Unitary Gating
ideas.problem_statement: Uniform attention allocation leads to high computational waste on uninformative background tokens.
ideas.core_mechanism: Calculate local Von Neumann entropy across sequence blocks and dynamically apply unitary Givens rotations to project noise tokens to zero.
ideas.key_assumptions: Background noise tokens exhibit low entropic contribution to final logit distributions.
ideas.expected_impact: 4.2x speedup in long-document summarization with zero degradation in ROUGE scores.

evaluation.critique: High novelty in combining spectral decomposition, but Chebyshev polynomial bounds suffer from numerical instability in high-dimensional state space.
evaluation.suggested_causal_pivot: Pivot from unbounded Chebyshev polynomials to bounded Legendre orthogonal polynomials with adaptive spectral truncation.

ideas.title: Hierarchical Spectral Routing for Sub-Linear Long-Context Attention
ideas.problem_statement: Standard Transformer quadratic attention scales poorly to million-token contexts, while sparse approximations cause context fragmentation.
ideas.core_mechanism: Decompose key-value projections into orthogonal Chebyshev polynomials, routing tokens dynamically via state-space frequency gating.
ideas.key_assumptions: High-frequency attention components dominate local syntax while low-frequency components capture global semantics.
ideas.expected_impact: O(N log N) time complexity with 99.4% retrieval accuracy on Needle-in-a-Haystack benchmark.

evaluation.critique: High novelty in combining spectral decomposition, but Chebyshev polynomial bounds suffer from numerical instability in high-dimensional state space.
evaluation.suggested_causal_pivot: Pivot from unbounded Chebyshev polynomials to bounded Legendre orthogonal polynomials with adaptive spectral truncation.
